integrity: The explicit natural chain-level identifications and integral Mayer-Vietoris sequences provide the universal proof; signed fixed-simplex enumerations reproduce predicted Lefschetz characters for finite cases.
scientific_limitations: The non-equivariant sphere multiplicities and general tree vertex decomposability are prior work, not newly asserted. The theorem treats precisely the stated caterpillar family and natural integral automorphism modules; it does not establish an equivariant wedge splitting or a classification for general trees. Finite checker cases are corroboration only.
title: Integral symmetry modules for higher-independence complexes of two-ended subdivided double stars
